status: FROZEN at step S0 (2026-10-25), before any crystal endpoint was computed; no MD coordinate has been read or scored; the parameters are design choices fixed before any data were read, not calibrated values

system.numbering: UniProt P01116-2 (KRAS4B), residues 4-164, topology resid = reference index

endpoint.evidence_class: external static structural proxy, already exposed during KRAS-STRUCT-2 development; not held out, not prospective, not independent validation, not functional ground truth

inputs.identity_checks: file SHA-256 equals the value recorded in the spec; ATOM records only; no alternate locations and no insertion codes; Asp at residue 12 in all 8 chains; residue names equal the MD topology sequence (recorded in feasibility_metadata.json) at every scored residue except residue 12

scored_residues.frozen_struct2_set_check: observed set within 1-166 must equal 1-59 and 68-166 (158 residues)

pair_fit.method: Kabsch, proper rotation (det +1), float64, on all scored Calpha of the two chains of the pair
pair_fit.trim: displace every scored residue after the first fit; drop the floor(trim_fraction x n) most displaced (ties: lower residue number dropped first); refit once on the rest; displacements are those of every scored residue under the refit

endpoint.between_state: mean over the 12 GDP x GNP chain pairs of the pair displacement (each pair fitted separately)
endpoint.within_state: maximum over the 16 same-entry chain pairs (1 in 5US4, 15 in 5USJ) of the pair displacement at that residue
endpoint.positive_rule: between_state >= max(min_displacement_A, within_state_factor x within_state) at that residue
endpoint.boundary: the comparison is inclusive; values within 1e-9 A of the threshold count as meeting it and are listed in the record as boundary residues

segments.merge_rule: two positives belong to one segment if residue_number(next) - residue_number(previous) - 1 <= merge_gap
segments.segment_length: number of endpoint-positive residues in the segment

gate.meaning: determines only whether the proxy contains a sufficiently distributed comparison target; it does not show that the endpoint can discriminate methods

sensitivity_reported_only.name: primary_pair_only
sensitivity_reported_only.definition: between_state taken from the single pair 5US4 chain A x 5USJ chain A; the same within_state values and the same positive rule

sensitivity_reported_only.name: median_over_pairs
sensitivity_reported_only.definition: between_state taken as the median instead of the mean over the 12 pairs; the same within_state values and the same positive rule

endpoint.sensitivity_note: reported with |E|, segments and Jaccard with E; they never change E, the gate or the decision

scoring.per_residue_score: maximum over the windows covering the residue of E = median cross-condition run-pair distance minus the larger within-condition median (no thresholds, no robust-in-both-sets filter)
scoring.ranking_tie_break: score descending, then residue number ascending, identical for every method
scoring.undefined_scores: residues without a finite score are ranked last and are never flagged; if a method has fewer than k finite scores it flags all of them and the shortfall counts as misses (the denominator stays k)

channel_selection.selected: once, from the primary analysis (all retained runs, full window 300-2000 ns), as the candidate with the highest precision at k
channel_selection.tie_break: the order of the candidate list above
channel_selection.fixed_in_sensitivity: T* and B* stay fixed for every balanced-subset, time-half and leave-one-run-out calculation; no winning channel is reselected inside a sensitivity analysis

decision.precision_is_exact_fraction: m / k with m the number of flagged residues in E; comparisons use integer arithmetic
decision.C1: none of the five decision channels (kappa, tau, d_i_i2, d_i_i3, rmsf) has 2 * m >= k in the primary analysis; the phi/psi comparator is never part of a decision
decision.C2: not C1, and at least one of: the primary gap is below delta; the Jaccard condition fails; the segment condition fails
decision.C3: not C1, not C2, and the gap is at least delta in every one of: the primary analysis; at least 90 % of the balanced subsets; both predefined time halves; every leave-one-run-out recomputation
decision.C4: not C1, not C2, and C3 not met

balanced_subsets.definition: all subsets of n_GDP retained GTP runs against all retained GDP runs, where n_GDP is the number of retained GDP runs
balanced_subsets.min_count_rule: ceil(0.9 * N) with N the number of subsets

decision.leave_one_run_out: every retained run is left out once (15 recomputations when all runs are retained)

jaccard_condition.sets: the top-k flagged sets of T* and of the baseline matched to T* (kappa to d_i_i2, tau to d_i_i3), not restricted to E

segment_condition.X: residues of E that T* flags and B* does not flag
segment_condition.holds_when: X lies in at least 2 distinct segments of E (merge rule of the endpoint)

decision.reading_of_C3: justifies only a separately frozen, genuinely prospective evaluation on another system; it is not evidence of functional or clinical validity
